items.t: SAP (XTRA:SAP) In Focus After Leadership Exit As Undervalued View Holds
items.sum: SAP (XTRA:SAP) is back in focus after investors reacted to the planned exit of Chief Customer Officer and Executive Board member Thomas Saueressig. The share price declined 5.2%, and options activity turned bearish.
